en.bilal-muhammad: Ja`far b. Muhammad b. Masrur narrated to us. He said: Al-Husayn b. Muhammad b. `Amer narrated to us from his uncle `Abdullah b. `Amer from al-Hasan b. Mahbub from Muqatil b. Sulayman. He said:

Abu `Abdillah (as) said: When Musa (as) climbed Tur and his Lord whispered to him, he said: O Lord! Show me your treasure. He said: O Musa! Surely, My treasure is that, when I will a thing, I say to it “be!” and it is.
